Function reference

Automatic calendar variation model

The proposed two-level model with automatic specification.

lunarcast()
Automatic two-level calendar variation model
forecast(<lunarcast>)
Forecasts from a calendar variation model
holiday_effects()
Holiday effects of a fitted model

Classical calendar variation model

Holiday-month dummy with a constant effect (structures m1 to m6).

calvar_classic()
Classical calendar variation model
calvar_classic_all()
The six classical calendar variation models
forecast(<calvar_classic>) forecast(<calvar_classic_set>)
